definition: Five independent contexts/source/condition, 50/500 notes in normal 4/12 columns, 375/1440x900, AB/BA order. Synchronous synthetic input/click/key/pointer dispatch; two rAF proxy, save indicator followed by exact state reload. Save timing preserves 160ms debounce. When enabled, CDP firstRendererPaintMs is mark to first same-renderer Paint before the next operation; it does not prove complete result presentation. Disabled/no Paint = null. Not physical input/display/INP, real IME or touch.
